influences.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
influences.decision: Adopt hidden activation dropout as the sole controlled factor: baseline A uses probability 0 and comparison B uses 0.25. After reading baseline feedback, execute the prespecified comparison. Retain A because B does not improve final-epoch validation accuracy.
influences.code_location: train.py: main(), --dropout argument, spec construction and build(spec); epoch loop calls model.train(); validate() calls model.eval(). The reviewed fashion_study_models.py builder supplies the registered architecture and dropout layer.
influences.observed_result: Published job metrics report final validation accuracy 0.9092 for A and 0.9056 for B: B minus A is -0.36 percentage points, or 18 fewer correct predictions among 5000. B has lower validation cross-entropy, but accuracy determines selection. The hypothesized accuracy benefit was not observed.
influences.limitations: Mechanism transfer, not exact reproduction or a source-established optimal probability. This study uses Fashion-MNIST, the approved width32/hidden128 CNN, raw [0,1] inputs, five epochs and Adam without a schedule. The inspected paper experiments use other architectures and discuss SGD, momentum, learning-rate decay, max-norm and other retention probabilities. Exact paper preprocessing and per-experiment epoch counts are not asserted. One seed and split cannot establish general dropout superiority or inferiority. Paper reading coverage is recorded in the inherited source manifest; full-paper reading is not claimed.
